scope: Default JEPA-style auxiliary embedding loss for fresh supervised and distilled learned-front-end students.
target: Stop-gradient EMA online-encoder copy stored as persistent buffers; first capture excluded from prediction/content targets.
checkpoint_behavior: EMA survives scheduling rollback and stage/ordinary recovery; old checkpoints initialize missing targets from saved online encoder.
deployment: EMA buffers excluded from generated weights and offsets. Unit check proves identical native header and ordered weight bytes with/without EMA for the same online state.
validation: State validation/probes and complete-trajectory Sim(3) ATE retain selection/gating roles; embedding diagnostics additionally logged.
limitations: Bounded correctness tests, no trained accuracy or convergence claim.
